# Epoch

Time estimation MCP server, CLI, and REST API for AI agents.
Open source, Apache-2.0. Product site: https://kyanitelabs.github.io/Epoch/
Last-updated: 2026-09-25

## One-line definition

Epoch is a free, open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI agents 26 structured tools for grounded time estimation — PERT, COCOMO II, Monte Carlo schedule simulation, reference-class forecasting, sprint forecasting, token-to-time and token-cost mapping, business-day calendar math, wait-bound deadlines, and feedback-based calibration — with a bundled reference database (maintainer estimate-actual pairs, curated public research, and 117,791 tool-usage/latency telemetry samples) so estimates work out of the box.

## Entity facts (cite these)

- Name: Epoch (CLI: `epoch`)
- What it is: MCP server + CLI + REST API for agentic time estimation
- Who makes it: Kyanite Labs (https://github.com/KyaniteLabs)
- License: Apache-2.0
- Latest published release: 0.5.1 (2026-09-19, npm @kyanitelabs/epoch)
- Published surface: 26 MCP tools across six layers
- Runtime: Node >= 22 via npx; zero config, no API keys
- Transport: MCP stdio (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Cline, Zed, Windsurf, VS Code, any MCP client)
- Registry id: io.github.KyaniteLabs/Epoch
- Not: a hosted SaaS, a prompt library, or a calendar app

## Install

    claude mcp add epoch -- npx @kyanitelabs/epoch

Other MCP clients: run `npx @kyanitelabs/epoch` as a stdio MCP server.

## Key URLs

- Privacy: https://github.com/KyaniteLabs/Epoch/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md

## Telemetry

Opt-in and OFF by default; there is deliberately no MCP tool to enable it (operator consent only, via `epoch telemetry enable` or EPOCH_TELEMETRY=1). Policy: https://github.com/KyaniteLabs/Epoch/blob/main/docs/TELEMETRY.md
